_doc: Peer-reviewed papers and public talks by SOMIN co-founder Prof. Aleks Farseev and the SOMIN research team. Every item was checked on the source page in source_checked (Semantic Scholar, Crossref, ojs.aaai.org, publisher pages, YouTube). Shown on /research/ and by the <!--mm:research--> shortcode. Do not add an item without a source page; no AggregateRating-style claims.

themes.title: Audience profiling from many data sources
themes.body: How to learn who an audience is from posts, images, check-ins and sensors across several networks at once, and why the data source changes what a model learns.

themes.title: Personality-driven content
themes.body: Inferring an audience's personality from its content and using it to choose and generate the posts that audience responds to.

themes.title: Scoring creative before launch
themes.body: Predicting how an ad creative will perform from its text, image, targeting and settings, then explaining the score so a marketer can act on it.
themes.product: Pre-scored concepts and paid-media ad scoring

themes.title: Explainable AI and LLMs for competitor analytics
themes.body: Combining performance models with large language models to read competitors' communications and say why something works, not only that it does.

themes.title: Agentic AI and strategy co-creation
themes.body: Agents that retrieve real context data before they write, so content stays distinctive instead of converging on the same generic output.
themes.product: SOMIN AI agents and the free Claude plugin

themes.title: Creator and influencer analytics
themes.body: Finding the right creators and accounts, classifying social posts with less labelling, and telling personal, brand and celebrity accounts apart.

themes.title: Responsible AI in advertising
themes.body: The ethics and privacy questions raised by automated profiling, ad targeting and generative creative.
